title: System Demo: Tool and Infrastructure for Offensive Language Error Analysis (OLEA) in English

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating offensive language detection performance on text written in African American English (AAE) using dialect proportion scores derived from the TwitterAAE model to check for over-detection of the dialect as offensive.
